name: v2.24.0
body:
## What's Changed


### Added

- **core:** a running gateway now shows each tool's computed digest. Every tool in
  `hangar_tools`, `GET /api/tools` and `GET /api/mcp_servers/{id}/tools` carries
  `digest`, the SHA-256 schema fingerprint `mcp-hangar pin` computes. ([#1646](https://github.com/mcp-hangar/mcp-hangar/pull/1646))
- **observability:** A cold start now shows how long the launch itself took: each launcher opens an `mcp_server.launch` span. ([#1571](https://github.com/mcp-hangar/mcp-hangar/pull/1571))

### Fixed

- **core:** affected versions <= 2.23.0 dropped a field in {a few} records. ([#1700](https://github.com/mcp-hangar/mcp-hangar/pull/1700))
- An item with no scope.

### Security

- **security:** An L7 egress header selector no longer matches an `Mcp-Param-*` header nothing checked. ([#1598](https://github.com/mcp-hangar/mcp-hangar/pull/1598))

## Installation

**PyPI:**
```bash
pip install mcp-hangar==2.24.0
```
